extracted.name: Slow cooker turkey casserole
extracted.description: Avoid food waste and turn your leftover Christmas turkey into this comforting casserole packed with veg. Making it in a slow cooker saves effort and energy costs
ingredient_lines: ½ swede peeled and roughly chopped
700g turkey cut into large pieces (or use the same amount of leftover roasted turkey)
½ small bunch of sage leaves picked and chopped
griddled bread or cooked potatoes, to serve
instruction_lines: Tip the onions, carrots, leek, swede, parsnips and turkey into a slow cooker. Sprinkle over the flour, then mix to combine everything.
Add the sage, bay leaves, mustard and tomato purée, and mix well. Pour in the stock, season well and give everything a quick stir. Cook on low for 8 hrs, or high for 3 hrs 30 mins.
